characters.description: Cinematic 3D devotional Krishna: youthful serene face, blue skin, peacock-feather crown, yellow pitambar, ornate traditional jewelry.
Cinematic 3D devotional Radha: graceful youthful appearance, traditional Vrindavan attire, delicate jewelry, expressive eyes.

locations.description: Moonlit Vrindavan beside the Yamuna, kadamba trees, flowers, soft mist, fireflies and reflective water.

supporting_assets.description: Traditional Indian bansuri flute, natural bamboo, finely crafted, cinematic 3D prop reference.
Indian peacock with natural blue-green plumage and detailed feathers, cinematic 3D animal reference.
